name: subject-advisors-p004-auth
description: P004-only validation harness; merge into FOUNDATION workspace tooling on integration.

scripts.test: node tools/integration/prepare.mjs && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.auth.config.ts
scripts.lint: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js apps tools/auth/local tools/integration tools/cloudflare vite.auth.config.ts vite.cloudflare.config.ts --max-warnings 0
scripts.build:local: node tools/integration/prepare.mjs && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config vite.auth.config.ts
scripts.check:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js --config wrangler.jsonc deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-cloudflare/worker
scripts.types:local: node node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js types tools/auth/local/worker-env.d.ts --config wrangler.auth.jsonc --env-interface LocalAuthEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.lint:offerings: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js apps/api/src/modules/offerings apps/web/src/features/offerings packages/shared/src/offerings tools/offerings/demo vite.offerings.config.ts vitest.offerings.config.ts --max-warnings 0
